Lemma
[$ u $-invariant monotonicity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0402 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants ↗ lem:chow-ii-appd-mu-monotonicity 1. appD:D.43\group Perelman Invariants

Along a closed Ricci flow, $ u (g(t))$ is nondecreasing whenever it is finite and defined. If $\lambda >0$ and $ u $ is constant on an interval, the flow is a gradient shrinking soliton. If $ u (g(t_0))=-\infty $, then $ u (g(t))=-\infty $ for every $t\leq t_0$.
